name: @pipeworx/mcp-paris-events

tools.name: events
tools.description: Find current "things to do" in Paris (Que Faire à Paris, City of Paris official events). Filter by keyword, free admission, and date window. Returns events sorted by start date. Note: titles/descriptions are in French.

query.description: Keyword (full-text), e.g. "jazz", "exposition", "marché". French terms match best.

free_only.description: If true, only free events (price_type = gratuit).

from.description: Include events running on/after this date YYYY-MM-DD (default: today). Ongoing/undated events are included.

to.description: Include events starting on/before this date YYYY-MM-DD.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-paris-events forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the paris-events pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
